tasks.name: הרצף הפנוי הארוך ביומן
tasks.src: m=>{ let best=0, cur=0; for(let i=0;i<4;i++){ if((m>>i)&1) cur=0; else { cur++; if(cur>best) best=cur; } } return best; }
tasks.note: Schedule bitmask (bit set = busy slot): length of the longest run of free (0) bits among the 4 slots.

tasks.name: המקום שלי בטבלה
tasks.note: Leaderboard place of my score against two rivals: 1 plus the number of strictly higher scores (ties share the better place).

tasks.name: דקות חפיפה בין פגישות
tasks.note: Overlap of two meetings of equal length starting at s1 and s2: length minus the start gap, floored at 0.

tasks.name: כמה להזמין למלאי
tasks.note: Restock rule: if stock is below the minimum, order enough to fill up to 15, otherwise order nothing.

tasks.name: ההזמנה שחצתה את 20
tasks.src: l=>{ let s=0; for(const x of l){ s+=x; if(s>20) return x; } return 0; }
tasks.note: Running total over orders: returns the order value at which the total first exceeds 20, or 0 if it never does.

tasks.name: כמה לא במקום בתור
tasks.note: Counts positions whose element differs from the ascending-sorted list (0 means the queue is already in order).

tasks.name: דלי הדירוג של הממוצע
tasks.src: l=>{ const n=l.length; if(!n) return 0; const s=l.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0); return s<10*n?1:(s<12*n?2:3); }
tasks.note: Buckets the mean rating without dividing: 1 if mean<10, 2 if mean<12, else 3; empty list gives 0.

tasks.name: התא הפנוי הבא
tasks.src: l=>{ if(!l.length) return 8; let v=l[l.length-1]; for(let k=0;k<7;k++){ v=v===15?8:v+1; if(!l.includes(v)) return v; } return 0; }
tasks.note: Round-robin locker allocation: the first locker in 8..15 not taken, searching cyclically after the most recently taken one (last element); empty gives 8, all taken gives 0.

tasks.name: פודיום: כסף, זהב, ארד
tasks.note: Podium layout: second place, then first, then third (fewer when the list is short).

tasks.name: קיצוץ העגלה לתקציב 40
tasks.src: l=>{ const r=[...l]; while(r.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0)>40){ r.splice(r.indexOf(Math.max(...r)),1); } return r; }
tasks.note: Over budget: repeatedly removes the most expensive item until the cart total is at most 40, keeping the remaining items in order.

tasks.name: פריט אחד מכל קטגוריה
tasks.src: l=>{ const seen=new Set(); return l.filter(x=>{ const c=x%4; if(seen.has(c)) return false; seen.add(c); return true; }); }
tasks.note: Keeps only the first item of each category (category = value mod 4), preserving order.

tasks.name: העמוד האחרון
tasks.note: Pagination with 3 items per page: returns the items on the last page (1 to 3 items), empty for an empty list.
